findings.title: Palestinian youth wounded by Israeli drone fire in central Gaza
findings.location: Al-Daawa area, northeast of Nuseirat refugee camp, central Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: One Palestinian youth reportedly wounded by Israeli drone gunfire and transported to hospital, according to a medical source. Distinct from earlier Jabalia and Al-Mawasi injuries and the Tel al-Hawa vehicle strike.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A medical source reported that the youth was brought to hospital after being directly shot by an Israeli drone in the al-Daawa area, northeast of the camp.
findings.source_type: Palestinian official news agency reporting a medical source

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Direct WAFA homepage check after official-first OCHA and WHO and 12 targeted searches; then opened WAFA article
bounded_discovery_context.publication_time_basis: WAFA page 21/November/2026 06:05 PM, Gaza local UTC+02:00, equivalent 08:05 PST
bounded_discovery_context.prior_overlap: Predecessor contains no Nuseirat/al-Daawa drone-injury report; earlier seven injuries concern Jabalia and Al-Mawasi, not this location.
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: Single medical-source account relayed by WAFA; identity, age, condition, exact injury time and independent corroboration unavailable. Do not infer a death or hospital capacity change.

findings.title: World Central Kitchen says Gaza food-carrying vehicle struck in Tel al-Hawa was not affiliated with it
findings.location: Tel al-Hawa, Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: World Central Kitchen explicitly denied affiliation with the food-carrying vehicle struck in the already recorded incident. This corrects the possible inference of WCK involvement from branded papers seen in the vehicle. The three fatalities are previously counted; no additional deaths or confirmed WCK-staff casualties.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: World Central Kitchen, an aid organisation that distributes food in the Gaza Strip, said, however, that the vehicle was not affiliated with it.
findings.source_type: Established international wire agency directly attributing organization response to World Central Kitchen

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Reuters article revisited during targeted search and direct opening; new attributed response not present in 06:47 and 07:41 predecessor context
bounded_discovery_context.publication_time_basis: Reuters original publication 2026-11-21 13:53 UTC (05:53 PST); its later article update includes the WCK denial but has no verifiable update timestamp ('Updated ago'). It cannot be proven that WCK responded during this hour.
bounded_discovery_context.prior_overlap: Same Tel al-Hawa three-fatality vehicle strike; prior 06:47 watch reported WCK-branded papers and no response from WCK. This finding supersedes any suggestion of actual WCK affiliation without adding casualty counts.
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: Denial of WCK affiliation does not disprove presence of food, branded papers or witness account of intended distribution. Does not independently establish another organization's ownership, the victims' roles, or a program-wide disruption.
